request.task: Describe your study routine, recent progress and plans for finishing a project.
request.essay: I usually study on Fridays, but this week I have been studying every day. I have already written three essays today. I have just finished my homework, but I have not checked it yet. While I was reading yesterday, my tutor called me. I had completed the first exercise before she arrived. By the time she visits tomorrow, I will have finished the project. I have known my tutor since 2010. I have worked with her for five years, and I have been hoping to improve my writing.

tenseAnalysis.example: I usually study on Fridays, but this week I have been studying every day.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: La frase comienza con 'I usually study', que establece un marco de tiempo presente para la rutina habitual.

clauses.quote: this week I have been studying every day

tenseAnalysis.example: I have already written three essays today.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: El uso de 'I have already written' indica una acción completada en el presente, relevante para el día actual.

clauses.quote: I have already written three essays today

tenseAnalysis.example: I have just finished my homework, but I have not checked it yet.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: La frase 'I have just finished my homework' muestra una acción reciente completada, mientras que 'I have not checked it yet' indica una acción que aún no ha ocurrido.

clauses.quote: I have just finished my homework
I have not checked it yet

tenseAnalysis.example: While I was reading yesterday, my tutor called me.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: La frase 'While I was reading yesterday' establece un contexto pasado para la acción de leer, y 'my tutor called me' es una acción que ocurrió en ese contexto.

tenseAnalysis.example: I had completed the first exercise before she arrived.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: La frase 'I had completed the first exercise before she arrived' muestra una acción completada antes de otra acción en el pasado.

clauses.quote: I had completed the first exercise

tenseAnalysis.example: By the time she visits tomorrow, I will have finished the project.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: La frase 'By the time she visits tomorrow, I will have finished the project' establece un marco de tiempo futuro para la finalización del proyecto.

clauses.quote: By the time she visits tomorrow

tenseAnalysis.example: I have known my tutor since 2010.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: La frase 'I have known my tutor since 2010' indica una acción que comenzó en el pasado y continúa en el presente.

clauses.quote: I have known my tutor since 2010

tenseAnalysis.example: I have worked with her for five years, and I have been hoping to improve my writing.
tenseAnalysis.explanation: La frase 'I have worked with her for five years' muestra una acción que ha estado ocurriendo durante un periodo de tiempo que continúa en el presente.

clauses.quote: I have worked with her for five years
